explanation: DATE '2026-01-05' - INTERVAL 30 DAY is midnight at the start of 6 December 2025, so the filter keeps every order from 6 December on. The data stops on 31 December, so the days left are 6 to 31 December: 26 rows, one per day, not 30. A window counted back from the as-of date can reach past the last day with data.
